newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador orders arrest of former President Bucaram.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador orders arrest of former President Bucaram.

text.p: Ecuador's Supreme Court on Wednesday ordered the arrest of former president Abdala Bucaram, who is suspected of misuse of presidential funds.
The ruling by Supreme Court President Carlos Solorzano -- obtained by Reuters -- also ordered the arrest of Bucaram's former aide Marco Albuja on the same charge.
The ruling came a month after the Supreme Court began investigating Bucaram for misuse of "reserved funds" directly controlled by the presidency.

Bucaram, who lives in exile in Panama and is also being investigated in another case of suspected corruption, was deposed by Congress in February on grounds of "mental deficiency" just months after taking office.
